wizards.title: Dark Wizards
wizards.tabTitle: Dark Wizards: guided helpers that prepare Generate for you
wizards.intro: Pick a wizard, give it a picture and a few words. It chooses the model and settings and prepares Generate; you check the Run Plan and press Run there.
wizards.replace.name: Replace
wizards.replace.summary: Swap a person, object or detail in a picture for something else.
wizards.replace.hint.reference: The picture goes to Generate as the reference of a Qwen Image 2.1 edit, at its own aspect ratio. Check the result size and press Run.
wizards.replace.hint.inpaint: Generate opens the picture in Inpaint with your text as the prompt. Paint over what should change, then press Run.
wizards.picture.chooseTitle: Choose the picture or video to change
wizards.picture.emptyBody: Or paste one with Ctrl+V, or use Choose… (PNG, JPEG or WebP; the picture to change may also be an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video)
wizards.picture.unsupported: Wizards take PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures; the picture to change may also be an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video.
wizards.picture.noInput: A pasted picture is saved to the Input folder first; set up the backend so DEAS knows that folder.
wizards.picture.size: The picture size could not be read; choose it again.
wizards.method.title: Method
wizards.method.noModel: No installed model for this method.
wizards.models.missing: No suitable model is installed. The wizard prefers {name}; the Library shows it with its license before anything is downloaded.
wizards.models.rescanHint: Checks the model folders again, for example after copying or downloading a model.
wizards.prepareNote: Nothing runs yet: Generate shows the draft and its Run Plan.
wizards.run.native: One-click running needs the desktop app.
wizards.run.maskHint: The masked method finds its mask with SAM 3.1 from “Replace what” in Generate; that needs a SAM 3.1 checkpoint and the SAM3_Detect node.
wizards.run.maskTarget: Name what to replace: SAM 3.1 uses it to find the mask.
wizards.run.noMask: SAM 3.1 found no “{target}” in the picture. Draw the mask in Generate and press Run there.
wizards.run.stopHint: Shown while the wizard’s run is queued or drawing.
wizards.run.openHint: Shown when the wizard’s run made a picture or stopped with a message; the prepared draft is in Generate.
wizards.run.succeeded: Done — the picture shows here and in Generate’s queue.
wizards.run.unknown: The outcome is unknown; check Generate’s queue.
wizards.run.notStarted: Generate could not start the draft; its message says why.
wizards.run.noFile: The run finished without a picture file.
wizards.handoff.model: Generate cannot use the model the wizard chose. Press Look again in the wizard, or pick another model there.
wizards.search.installedOnly: Shown when a suitable model is installed.
wizards.search.missingOnly: Shown when no suitable model is installed.
wizards.picture.objectBody: A picture of what should go in: a person, a product, a piece of clothing… Paste or drop goes to the highlighted area.
wizards.picture.objectUnused: This model uses only the text. The object picture needs a Qwen Image 2.1 model (both methods can use one).
wizards.replace.replacementObjectPlaceho: optional: the dog in the object picture
wizards.replace.hint.referenceObject: The picture to change becomes image 1 and the object picture image 2 of a Qwen Image 2.1 reference edit; the result keeps image 1's aspect ratio. Check the result size and press Run.
wizards.replace.objectRouted: With an object picture the wizard hands over the reference edit on the same model: a masked edit would keep the old object.
wizards.picture.offGrid: This picture is {size}. Inpaint with this model needs both sides on a multiple of {grid} px, so Generate keeps Run blocked for this picture.
wizards.picture.gridCopyHint: Saves a centred {size} crop as a new picture in the Input folder and uses it here. Only the few edge pixels past the grid are cut, nothing is resampled; the original stays unchanged.
wizards.picture.gridCopySmall: This picture is too small to crop onto the grid; choose a larger one.
wizards.search.gridCopy: Shown only when the picture to change is off the model's grid for a masked method.
wizards.replace.multiTarget: All {count} targets ({targets}) become {replacement}. To give each its own replacement, run the wizard once per target.
wizards.replace.multiObject: the object from the second picture
wizards.picture.videoObject: A video goes into “Picture to change”; the object to put in must be a picture.
wizards.video.reading: Reading the clip and its first frame…
wizards.video.clip: Video {name} · {size} · {seconds} s — step 1 edits its first frame (shown above), step 2 makes the video.
wizards.video.title: Step 2 · Video method
wizards.replace.video.reanimate: Re-animate from the edited frame (MiniMax H3)
wizards.replace.video.hint.edit: Keeps the clip’s camera and motion and puts the edited first frame in; best for still or slow shots. In strongly moving shots the old object comes back after about a second. The clip’s sound is not kept.
wizards.replace.video.hint.reanimate: Animates a new clip from the edited first frame: the replacement stays, but the motion is new and does not follow the clip. It makes its own sound.
wizards.video.noModel: No installed model for this video method.
wizards.video.length: Uses the first {seconds} s of the {total} s clip.
wizards.video.notice: Strongly moving shots are not reliable yet with either method.
wizards.video.chained: The video step starts when the edited first frame is done.
wizards.run.videoSucceeded: Done — the video shows here and in Generate’s queue.
wizards.search.video: Shown when the picture to change is a video.
